description: DISPOSABLE-BLOAT fixture (mirror of debug-speclib): the agent must first read ~120k of design notes that contain NO fix info, then fix 24 modules whose behavior lives in tiny per-module docstrings. The notes are read once and never needed again, so an early reset can drop them and finish cheaply — the regime where early compaction should WIN.
note: phase1_turns is a placeholder — calibrate from a continue confirm-pilot so the reset fires just after the notes are read (context crosses 100k) and most module fixes remain for phase 2, maximizing turns_remaining for the reset arms.
